name: Khan Hratha
summary: At Gelkis Village, Uthek the Wise sends you against the Maraudine after your help against the Magram. Their leader, Khan Hratha, carries a piece of a key Uthek wants returned to him.

sections.title: Challenging the Maraudine
sections.body: The Gelkis need your help against the Maraudine, Uthek the Wise tells you. Their War Horn stands on a tall bluff in the Valley of Spears. Sound it, and Khan Hratha will answer. But first, you need a warhorn mouthpiece. Only trusted Maraudine centaur carry one, and they are rare. More centaur arrive when the horn sounds. Hratha comes last.

sections.title: A Piece of a Key
sections.body: Khan Hratha holds a piece of a key. Uthek wants you to bring it to Gelkis Village.

sections.title: On Your Return
sections.body: When you return, Uthek exults that Khan Hratha is dead and the Maraudine are doomed. He vows the Gelkis will remember you when they rule this land. The earth's spirits, he says, will sing your name forever.

faq.q: Who sends you to fight Khan Hratha?
faq.answer: Uthek the Wise sends you to fight Khan Hratha from Gelkis Village, after you have helped the Gelkis against the Magram.

faq.q: How is Khan Hratha brought out to fight?
faq.answer: Sound the Maraudine War Horn on a tall bluff in the Valley of Spears. Centaur answer first, and Khan Hratha follows.

faq.q: How do you blow the Maraudine War Horn?
aliases: how to use maraudine war horn
